name: Kameron Battle
strengths: Battle's best tape trait is one-cut vision — sees the crease on inside zone, plants, and attacks downhill without dancing behind the line.
Battle shows a real second gear once he clears the second level — stretches the edge on toss/sweep and pulls away from pursuit angles in the open field.
Battle finishes through arm tackles with forward lean and is comfortable on screens/swings — secures the catch, then turns upfield.
weaknesses: Battle's highlight package is more linear read-and-attack than elite phone-booth shake; pass-protection sample is thin on the reels.
comparison: Battle comps to James Cook — 5-10 / 5-11 lighter RB mold with one-cut vision, second-gear juice to the edge, and natural receiving comfort (size-matched; not a Florida-alum default).
projection: Battle projects as a Year-1 package / special-teams RB, Year-2 compete for change-of-pace rotation, with Year-3+ every-down contributor ceiling as a one-cut Tampa back who can stress the edge and catch out of the backfield.
schemeFit: Battle fits a zone/gap space RB room that values one-cut vision, edge juice, and backfield receiving.
staffNotes: FILM VERIFIED 2026-08-12 from Carrollwood Day sophomore (2025) + freshman (2024) Hudl highlight reels (watched).
